# NEW 2026-11-22 v16.0 Module 16.0-A: Ottoman Empire Playable Epic (oe_ptur_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v160_ottomans.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Initialize bounded Ottoman state variables (0-100) once.
oe_ptur_init_host = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ptur_janissary_power } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_ptur_janissary_power value = 35 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ptur_divan_authority } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_ptur_divan_authority value = 50 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ptur_modernization } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_ptur_modernization value = 15 }
	}
}

# Clamped 0-100 state adjusters.
oe_ptur_add_janissary = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ptur_janissary_power } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_ptur_janissary_power value = 35 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = oe_ptur_janissary_power add = $amt$ }
	clamp_variable = { name = oe_ptur_janissary_power min = 0 max = 100 }
}

oe_ptur_add_divan = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ptur_divan_authority } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_ptur_divan_authority value = 50 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = oe_ptur_divan_authority add = $amt$ }
	clamp_variable = { name = oe_ptur_divan_authority min = 0 max = 100 }
}

oe_ptur_add_modernization = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ptur_modernization } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_ptur_modernization value = 15 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = oe_ptur_modernization add = $amt$ }
	clamp_variable = { name = oe_ptur_modernization min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# Zero-slot yearly dispatcher exported for global kernel integration (oe_global_kernel_effects.txt).
# O(1) lookup via country_exists = c:TUR + per-year dedup via global_var:oe_ptur_ran_y ?= current_year.
oe_ptur_kernel_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { global_var:oe_ptur_ran_y ?= current_year }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_ptur_ran_y value = current_year }
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:TUR
				c:TUR = { is_rebel_country = no }
			}
			c:TUR = { oe_ptur_host_yearly = yes }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Fires at most one chronological Ottoman epic event per year (32 milestones, 1338-1836).
